summary: Scalar deleting-destructor (__thiscall): calls Destructor(this) to tear down the object, then frees the object memory via FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) only when flag a2 bit 0 is set. Returns this. The a2 flag follows the MSVC deleting-destructor convention where bit 0 selects free-after-destruct.

operations.description: Invoke Destructor(this) to run object teardown.
Guard on (a2 & 1) != 0 before freeing; when bit 0 of the flag is clear the object memory is kept.
Invoke FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) to release the object memory when the guard passes.
